title: Insight into the dynamic transformation properties of microplastic-derived dissolved organic matter and its contribution to the formation of chlorination disinfection by-products
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34338-34347
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05857G, Paper
Open Access

Yingyue Zhou, Feng Zeng, Kunyan Cui, Longxia Lan, Hao Wang, Weiqian Liang
PSMPs-DOM formed under prolonged irradiation showed higher chlorine reactivity but lower THMs formation potential. The conversion of humic-like substances influenced the THMs formation potential, with C1 being a more dominant factor.
